dcterms:description: A crowdsourced corpus of anaphoric information containing annotations for about 108,000 markables, with an average of 20 judgments per markable, totaling over 2.2 million judgments. The corpus features a rich annotation scheme covering singletons, expletives, and split-antecedent plurals, and includes labels inferred using a probabilistic model of annotation for coreference.
dcterms:title: Phrase Detectives Corpus
